text.text_excerpt: We ran across Mrs. Wheat's at the French Quarter festival and I was intrigued by their meat pies. Basically they are like empanadas and we got one each of the Cajun Meat pie and the Crawfish pie. The Cajun meat pie was like many other empanada type pies we've had, with a little more kick than usual because hey, it's Cajun meat. Pretty good, but not too newsworthy. But the crawfish pie... mmmm, now that was good! A good amount of crawfish inside, we'd definitely get this one again if we are back in NOLA!

This is the distribution location of Mrs. Wheat's Meat Pies....I remember eating these for the 1st time at the World's Fair in 1984. And they are delicious. The pies are deep fried so they must be good, right? Back then they had 2 kinds of meat (spicy & blah) and broccoli & cheese. They have been at Jazz Fest every weekend for decades. And now have dropped the non-spicy meat and added crawfish (really more like a crawfish dressing because it has rice too). I cannot tell you how much I love the broccoli & cheese pie.

This review is based on the meat pies I had at French Quarter Festival 2015. The meat pies and crawfish pies were probably one of my favorite items at the food fest. Anything empanada-like or meat pie like just attracts me and this one in particular has the perfect flaky crust. It's not too greasy and the filling is so well-seasoned. Other meat pies that you usually find in small convenience stores or gas stations tend to be dry with subpar filling, but this was amazing. Another plus is that I decided to order some to-go and it reheats very well. I haven't actually been to it's brick and mortar location, but if they could throw out pies like this at an outdoor food festival, who knows wha...
